source_policy: Reuse blur-v1 verified original / clean parents for BOTH effects: D-BLUR -> C-SPIRITS, D-GLARE -> C-MALT. No previous effect outputs as input. D-WARP retains original warp/mild blur.
comparison_exception: D-BLUR glare V1 inherited original blur; V2 now uses documented clean parent. Glare seed/location unchanged. Other glare sources unchanged.
wording: No retyping, generated pixels, inpainting or reconstruction. Source glyph geometry remains; lighting blends or convolution necessarily change RGB values, not literal pixel identity.
